post.description: Creates a new App Studio Component or updates an existing one if `forceUpdate` is true. Requires write auth.

id.description: Owner ID (required if owner type is 'app').

code.description: The source code for the Component.

transpiledCode.description: The transpiled code for the Component.

forceUpdate.description: If true, forces an update on an existing Component.

200.description: App Studio Component successfully created or updated.

400.description: Bad request, including missing required fields.

404.description: App Studio Component not found when force updating.

put.description: Updates an existing app studio component. Requires write auth.

parameters.name: componentId
parameters.description: ID of the App Studio Component to update

id.description: Owner ID (required if owner type is 'app').

code.description: The source code for the Component.

transpiledCode.description: The transpiled code for the Component.

forceUpdate.description: If true, forces an update on an existing Component.

200.description: App Studio Component successfully created or updated.

400.description: Bad request, including missing required fields.

404.description: App Studio Component not found when force updating.

get.summary: Get an App Studio Component by key.
get.description: Retrieves an App Studio Component by its key. Requires write auth.

parameters.name: componentKey
parameters.description: Key of the App Studio Component to retrieve (ex. "ProductCard")

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the app to retrieve component for.

get.summary: Get all App Studio Components for an app
get.description: Retrieves all App Studio Components for a specific app, as well as tapcart components, if specified. Requires write auth.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the app to retrieve App Studio Components for

parameters.name: includeTapcartComponents
parameters.description: Whether to include tapcart components as well

get.summary: Get versions of an App Studio Component
get.description: Retrieves all versions of an App Studio Component by its key. Requires write auth

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the app to retrieve App Studio Components for

parameters.name: componentKey
parameters.description: Key of the App Studio Component to retrieve versions for (ex. "ProductCard")

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: JSON string of the owner object to filter by

200.description: App Studio Component versions successfully retrieved

put.summary: Update the version index of an App Studio Component
put.description: Updates the active version of an App Studio Component by setting its version index. Requires write auth.

parameters.name: componentKey
parameters.description: Key of the App Studio Component to update (ex. "ProductCard")

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the app to retrieve component for.

versionIndex.description: The index of the version to set as active

owner.description: The owner object to filter by

200.description: App Studio Component version index successfully updated

400.description: Bad request, missing component label or invalid version index

404.description: App Studio Component or version not found

post.description: Creates a new BlockTemplate. Requires write auth.

id.description: Owner ID (required if owner type is 'app').

code.description: The encoded source code for the BlockTemplate.

transpiledCode.description: The encoded transpiled code for the BlockTemplate.

versionIndex.description: The index of the version to set (only used if force updating).

400.description: Bad request, including invalid `versionIndex` or missing required fields.

404.description: BlockTemplate not found when force updating.

put.description: Updates an existing block template if `forceUpdate` is true. Requires write auth.

parameters.name: blockTemplateId
parameters.description: ID of the block template to change to be updated

id.description: Owner ID (required if owner type is 'app').

code.description: The encoded source code for the BlockTemplate.

transpiledCode.description: The encoded transpiled code for the BlockTemplate.

forceUpdate.description: If true, forces an update on an existing BlockTemplate.

versionIndex.description: The index of the version to set (only used if force updating).

400.description: Bad request, including invalid `versionIndex` or missing required fields.

404.description: BlockTemplate not found when force updating.

put.summary: Update the versionIndex of an existing BlockTemplate.
put.description: Updates the `versionIndex` of a specified BlockTemplate by blockTemplateId.

parameters.name: blockTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the BlockTemplate to update.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The label of the BlockTemplate to update.

404.description: BlockTemplate not found with the specified blockTemplateId.

get.description: Retrieves a BlockTemplate along with the specified version based on `versionIndex`. Requires read auth

parameters.name: blockTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the BlockTemplate to retrieve.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The ID of the app.

parameters.name: versionIndex
parameters.description: The version index to retrieve. If not provided, the current versionIndex is used.

400.description: Invalid versionIndex or label not found.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of all merchant-owned custom block templates based on app id. Requires read auth.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The ID of the app

type.description: Either "tapcart" or "app" but will be "app" for templates in this response

code.description: Base64 string of code to be rendered in code editor

versions.description: Array of previously submitted block versions

post.summary: Update dependencies for a specific app.
post.description: Updates the dependencies of an app identified by the appId. Requires write auth

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The ID of the app.

404.description: No dependencies found for the given appId.

get.summary: Get dependencies for a specific app.
get.description: Retrieves the dependencies of an app identified by the appId.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The ID of the app.

404.description: No dependencies found for the given appId.
